YuriiHoliuk/budget-sync.message:
Fix rename input still losing focus after dropdown close

Defer handleStartEdit with requestAnimationFrame so it runs after
Radix DropdownMenu restores focus to the trigger button, preventing
the focus restoration from stealing focus and triggering onBlur.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix group rename input blur bug and add unallocate funds feature

Defer rename edit start until dropdown menu fully closes to prevent
blur-triggered dismissal. Add unallocate mode to move funds sheet
allowing users to return money to Ready to Assign without selecting
a destination budget.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix sibling lookup for manual transactions without bank links

findSiblingTransactions relied solely on bank_transaction links via
transactionSources, which don't exist for manual account transactions.
Add externalId-based fallback that parses the split-{sourceId}-* pattern
to find siblings when no bank transaction links are present.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix E2E build: make webpack config dev-only

Next.js 16 defaults to Turbopack and errors when it encounters a
webpack config without an explicit bundler flag. The webpack polling
config is only needed for Docker dev file watching, so conditionally
apply it only in development mode.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Improve seed data with deterministic generation and realistic scenarios

Rewrite seed script to use seeded PRNG for deterministic data, add
realistic merchant-category-budget alignment, multiple account types
including cash, auto-detected returns and fee splits, transfer
candidates, pending categorization transactions, and budget allocation
history across 3 months.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add split/join transactions and mark-as-returning features

Split transactions: split a transaction into multiple parts with
different categories/budgets while preserving the bank transaction link.
Join reverses a split by merging siblings back together.

Mark as returning: link credit transactions as returns of debit
transactions, with partial/full return support. Adds bank_transaction_returns
table for audit trail. Revert undoes the return linkage.

Includes domain errors, repository methods, use cases, GraphQL mutations,
frontend UI (split form, returning selection mode, confirmation dialogs),
cache utilities, and full test coverage (unit, API integration, E2E).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add cash account type and improve frontend form inputs

Add cash as a new account type across domain, mappers, and GraphQL.
Change monetary inputs from type=number to type=text inputMode=decimal
for better mobile UX. Fix popover/searchable-select portaling in sheets,
add none-filter option for uncategorized/unbudgeted filtering, add
category assignment to unbudgeted transactions warning, and enable
webpack polling for Docker dev.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Reduce webhook costs and add webhook re-registration to sync job

Add cpu_idle and startup_cpu_boost to webhook Cloud Run service to reduce
costs while keeping minScale=1. Extract RegisterWebhook use case and
integrate it into SyncAccountsJob so webhooks are re-registered every
sync cycle as a safety net. Pass WEBHOOK_URL env var through Terraform.

Fix amount sign convention: enforce positive amounts in all write paths

The webhook path (ProcessIncomingTransaction) was storing raw signed
amounts from Monobank, violating the positive-amount convention. This
caused detectReturningForTransaction to compare positive refund amounts
against negative originals, triggering full refunds instead of partial.

Fixes:
- ProcessIncomingTransaction: Math.abs(txData.amount) for transaction amount
- DatabaseTransactionMapper.getAmount(): Math.abs() safety net
- Migration script: detect already-reduced amounts to avoid double-subtraction

full refunds delete the transaction entirely.

Also fixes amount sign convention (transactions.amount is now always positive),
removes markAsReturning/unmarkReturning mutations, updates seed data, and
fixes flaky budget-groups E2E test.

Fix backfill transfer detection: remove incorrect ID ordering constraint

The t1.id < t2.id dedup condition incorrectly assumed the debit
transaction always has a lower ID than the credit. Since the query
already enforces t1.type='debit' AND t2.type='credit', each pair
appears exactly once without needing ID ordering.

card-to-card transfers have NULL counterparty fields. Move transfer
detection from domain-layer synchronous IBAN matching to application-layer
post-processing that pairs transactions by matching absolute amount,
opposite type (credit/debit), across different own accounts within ±5 min.

[Build]: Detect stale ECR images for PR build dependency resolution (#89)

When a PR triggers E2E tests, check if existing ECR images are stale
by diffing builtCommit against the current master tip. If unbuilt
service changes exist, trigger a rebuild. This fixes false test
failures caused by stale images while preserving the PR #83
optimization that avoids unnecessary lint/typecheck jobs.
